Student Report Generator Using Streams & Formatted I/O

Problem Statement:
You are required to build a Student Report Generator using C++ streams and formatted output.

🔹 Requirements

1️⃣ Read number of students n.

2️⃣ For each student, read:

Name
Marks1
Marks2
Marks3

3️⃣ Compute:

Total

Average (2 decimal places)

4️⃣ Display formatted output as a table:

--------------------------------------------------
Name        M1    M2    M3    Total    Average
--------------------------------------------------

Formatting rules:

Use setw() for alignment

Use left for name

Use right for numbers

Use fixed and setprecision(2) for average

🔹 Input Format
n
name1 m1 m2 m3
name2 m1 m2 m3
...

🔹 Output Format

Proper aligned table with totals and average.
